sentences.text: Bellusaurus was a sauropod dinosaur from the Late Jurassic known from juvenile specimens estimated to be about 4.8 meters long.
The estimated length of Bellusaurus is 4.8 meters, a figure based on juvenile individuals.
Some features suggest that the seventeen individuals found in the quarry were all juveniles.
The only known species, Bellusaurus sui, was formally described by Dong Zhiming in 1991.

The specific name sui honors Senior Preparator Youling Sui, while the genus name Bellusaurus derives from Latin and Greek words meaning beautiful lizard, reflecting the sauropods' small and lightly built nature.
A 2023 study proposed that Bellusaurus is a mamenchisaurid.
The Paleobi Database lists the parent group of Bellusaurus as Mamenchisauridae.
Fossils of Bellusaurus were found in the Shishugou Formation in the northeastern Junggar Basin in China.
